name: Database:List
sql: SELECT name, state_desc, recovery_model_desc FROM sys.databases ORDER BY name

name: Database:SizeMB
sql: SELECT CAST(ROUND(SUM(size)*8.0/1024.0,2) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) FROM sys.database_files

name: Database:LogSizeMB
sql: SELECT CAST(ROUND(SUM(size)*8.0/1024.0,2) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) FROM sys.database_files WHERE type_desc='LOG'

name: Sessions:UserConnections
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions WHERE is_user_process=1

name: Sessions:RunningRequests
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys.dm_exec_requests WHERE session_id > 50

name: Sessions:WaitingRequests
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys.dm_exec_requests WHERE wait_type IS NOT NULL AND session_id > 50

name: Sessions:List
sql: SELECT session_id, login_name, host_name, program_name, status, database_id FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions WHERE is_user_process=1 ORDER BY session_id

name: Performance:LongRunningOver60s
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys.dm_exec_requests WHERE total_elapsed_time>60000 AND session_id>50

name: Performance:BlockedRequests
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys.dm_exec_requests WHERE blocking_session_id>0

name: Performance:BufferCacheHitPct
sql: SELECT TOP 1 CAST(ROUND(100.0*CAST(r.cntr_value AS FLOAT)/NULLIF(CAST(b.cntr_value AS FLOAT),0),2) AS FLOAT) FROM sys.dm_os_performance_counters r JOIN sys.dm_os_performance_counters b ON r.object_name=b.object_name AND b.counter_name='Buffer cache hit ratio base' WHERE r.counter_name='Buffer cache hit ratio' AND r.object_name LIKE '%Buffer Manager%'

name: Security:ServerLogins
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys.server_principals WHERE type IN ('S','U','G')

name: Security:DatabaseUsers
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys.database_principals WHERE type IN ('S','U','G')
